answer: For environmental survey grants, count verified hectares rather than agent accounts. Register the survey rights for each dune, lagoon or tundra parcel against a land record, and pay each square meter once per season. Compute the union of claimed polygons, so splitting or overlapping parcels cannot multiply eligible area. Extra aliases on the same land add nothing; a farmer must lease rights to additional acreage and fund inspections. This assumes reliable land records, exclusive survey rights and checks that the promised surveys were delivered.
